meetings.ours_headline: Committee heard the proposed FY24 school budget and sent a bus-transportation policy rewrite to the policy committee.
Committee approved the high school program of studies and line item transfers; FY24 budget got only an update.
Committee advanced a new K-6 bus-application policy to a second read, opened five school choice seats, and approved a concession stand monitor.
School Committee opened the stipend list in the teachers' contract, read two policies, and discussed Turkey Hill repairs.
Committee held off on a bus-application deadline policy, waived two reads, passed lunch policies and approved ESSER transfers.
School Committee held a first read of the revised transportation policy and set a second read for Monday 6:30.
School Committee waived the second reading of transportation policy 3601, then went into executive session on security.
Committee delayed its FY24 budget vote to March 22 and postponed the primary school AC vote to next week.
School Committee approved the FY24 recommended budget and the modified primary school air conditioning project, both by roll call.
Committee approved all line-item transfers, a grant-funded co-teaching coach posting, and a custodial negotiator; equity audit Q&A had no action.
Committee voted to send a letter asking that remaining ARPA funds go mostly to Marshall Park, plus a plow/sander and turf field.
Committee approved a year-end line-item transfer, new middle school ELA curriculum, four finance policies, and spending leftover ESSER funds on technology.
Committee reorganized with officers and assignments, and began a plan for Turkey Hill repairs, with no budget decisions.
School Committee heard principals explain how bullying reports are investigated and why parents feel unheard; no votes taken.
School Committee approved FY24 handbooks and calendar, and deferred the Turkey Hill future question to a summer meeting.
Committee approved carrying over open purchase orders and released class of 2023 funds, and accepted a furniture donation.
Committee adopted amended operating protocols and agreed to redraft a primary-school mini-split warrant article for its next meeting.
Committee backed a warrant article moving primary school climate-control money; Turkey Hill facilities plan debated.
